title: Parity next layer
statement: For natural numbers $r$ and $q$, form a list with one entry for each index in a layer of size $r^q2^r$. The entry at each index is the finite set of inputs to the corresponding node in the next layer, whose size is $r^{q+1}2^r$.
caveat: The rule defining the inputs to each next-layer node is an upstream definition not supplied in this request.
